title: Bleached corals thrive within days when touching healthy neighbour
why_read: An interesting marine biology finding about coral bleaching recovery, but tangential to software engineering interests.
analysis: This describes research showing bleached corals can recover quickly when physically touching healthy neighboring coral, suggesting some form of microbial or chemical transfer aids recovery. It's scientifically interesting and climate-relevant, but has no direct connection to software, systems, or engineering practice. Likely included on HN for general scientific curiosity rather than technical substance for engineers. Fine as an occasional change-of-pace story but not central to a technical digest.
